name: dsh-context-viewer
description: DeepSeek Harness 上下文查看器：浏览思考链、shell 命令、工具调用与结果的桌面应用

scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.dev: npm run build:main && concurrently -k -s first 'vite' 'wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron .'
scripts.pack: npm run build && electron-packager . 'DSH上下文查看器' --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --out=release --overwrite --asar
